title: Izinsika Eziphakeme Zezindunduma Ezipheshulwa Umoya
intro: Cabanga impucuko echumayo enesiphiwo samandla amakhulu kanye nekhono elingenakuqhathaniswa lokwakha. Njengoba yayihlala phakathi kwezindunduma ezinkulu nezigobile, lo mphakathi wakha izindawo ezinkulu ezithinta umkhathi. Kodwa ukuqhosha kwaqala, futhi ubizo lokubuyela ekukhulekeleni u-Allah kuphela lwahlangatshezwa ngokudelelwa. Okwalandela kusalokhu kuyisixwayiso esiqhutshwa emoyeni ngokwawo.
clues: Sasiyisizwe esinamandla esalandela abantu bakaNuh, sibusiswe ngokuphakama namandla amakhulu.
Sakha imibhoshongo ephakeme nezikhumbuzo kuzo zonke izindawo eziphakeme ngenxa yemidlalo nokuziqhenya nje.
Sazigqaja, sithi ngubani onamandla kunathi ngamandla, futhi senza ngobushiqela ngaphandle kwesihawu.
Salahla isithunywa sethu uHud lapho esibiza ukuba sikhonze u-Allah yedwa, simbiza ngokuthi ubuthakathaka futhi ungumqambimanga.
Sahleka usulu lesi sixwayiso futhi samphonsela inselelo yokuthi asilethele isijeziso asisongela ngaso uma ekhuluma iqiniso.
Sabhujiswa umoya onamandla nongenamanzi ubusuku obuyisikhombisa nezinsuku eziyisishiyagalombili, sashiywa siwe njengezihlahla zesundu ezingenalutho.

arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتَأْفِكَنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا فَأْتِنَا بِمَا تَعِدُنَآ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: They said, "Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful." (46:22)
